Strategy: Shift the sweet band further upward to residuals between forty and fifty-five while keeping the mid penalty, testing whether roomier leftovers work even better. This steers bins toward reusable middle residuals and away from awkward small gaps, but the shifted band may match fewer real item sizes.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 40 and r - item <= 55 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
